goal: Improve the probability quality of the displayed p_up/p_down (Brier, log loss, ECE, direction hit) for KOSPI and KOSDAQ next-session close versus the historical up-rate.
selection_exposure_disclosure: Incumbent development metrics (2024-10-25..2025-11-07) were already public and viewed before this registration, including the fact that the uncalibrated 'legacy' logistic scored better than the calibrated incumbent.

Prior worktree feat/robo-stock-accuracy-20261119 viewed MAE (not probability) results for KR/US yields, spreads and margin credit on the same 252 development sessions, and a rolling Laplace-252 up-rate probability (not repeated here).

The terminal block (as-of >= 2025-11-10) is burned. No candidate fitting, calibration, scoring or selection uses any row with as-of >= 2025-11-10; inputs are truncated at 2025-11-10 (the outcome date of the last development row).
Only data-quality checks (OHLC consistency, duplicates, coverage) were run on the new inputs before this registration; no outcome-based statistic of any candidate was computed.

common_protocol.anchors: fit_protocol.session_anchor XKRX, origin 2019-01-02, refit every 21 scheduled sessions; training rows from fit_protocol.make_fit_snapshot (expanding, purge 1 session, label matured at or before the anchor cutoff, finite features only)
common_protocol.missing_values: rows with a missing candidate feature are excluded from training and from scoring; never filled with zero
common_protocol.preprocessing: median imputer + StandardScaler fitted on the anchor's training rows only
common_protocol.model_for_logistic_candidates: sklearn LogisticRegression(C=0.01, l2, lbfgs, max_iter=2000); no OOF sigmoid recalibration; random_state 42 recorded (solver deterministic)

clocks.postclose: after_close_daily_v1: postclose.historical_cutoff = first KST weekday 18:00 after the XKRX close of T
clocks.premarket: premarket_final: 08:00 KST on target session T+1 (US session closing before that cutoff is available)

baselines_same_dates: up_rate: expanding Laplace up-rate of labels available at the cutoff (incumbent definition)
incumbent: linear:price with sigmoid OOF calibration (postclose walk via reliable._walk)
legacy: same linear price model, raw uncalibrated logistic C=1
previous_direction and simple_trend hard-direction references (uncalibrated; direction hit only meaningful)

scoring_windows.primary_extended_pre_terminal_oof: every as-of < 2025-11-10 where the postclose incumbent linear:price record is calibration_ready and the candidate has a prediction

common_protocol.bootstrap: paired moving-block bootstrap of per-session loss differences, 2000 draws, block 20, seed 42 (reliable._bootstrap)
slices: drawdown: close <= 0.90 x max close of prior 252 sessions

candidates.hypothesis: Price features carry at most a weak 1D signal; the incumbent's second-stage sigmoid recalibration fitted on 252 noisy OOF rows plus weak L2 adds variance. Strong L2 without recalibration should shrink toward the base rate and lower Brier variance.

The close-to-close return mixes the US-driven opening gap with the Korea-specific intraday move; intraday return, closing location and range (more efficient vol estimator) may carry end-of-day pressure/reversal information not in close-to-close features. Prior worktree's top recommended untested input.

features: credit_log_change_1/5/20 (own-market FreeSIS margin credit balance; observation D usable at the 18:00 cutoff of the 2nd XKRX session after D)
candidates.hypothesis: Retail leverage build-up/unwind (margin calls, forced selling) creates short-horizon continuation after credit contraction in Korea.
candidates.sensitivity: 1st-session-after-D availability (prior D+1 credit variant), reported, not separately gated

features: us1y_change_5obs_bp (ECOS KR / Treasury US par yields; observation D usable at the 18:00 cutoff of the 2nd XKRX session after D)
candidates.hypothesis: Discount-rate and policy-expectation shocks shift equity risk appetite; rising yields lower the next-session up-probability.

features: volatility_20d versus the training rows' median (high/low)
candidates.model: 4-cell expanding up-rate shrunk to the overall training up-rate with 20 pseudo-observations, refit at each anchor
candidates.hypothesis: The incumbent is anchored to the long-run up drift; the up-rate itself differs by volatility/trend regime (e.g. high-vol downtrends). A low-variance conditional base rate captures that without parametric noise.

features: sox_nasdaq_spread_1d (US session closing before 08:00 KST of T+1; close + 15 min buffer reconstruction)
candidates.hypothesis: The US session that trades after the 18:00 KST issue is the main driver of the KRX opening gap. A premarket cutoff that sees it should materially beat the base rate. Difference to C1 quantifies the information lost by issuing at 18:00. This is a different issuance clock/product, not a drop-in for the 18:00 card.

preregistered_ablations_not_gated: A1 premarket US-only (6 US features, no price), C6 model
A2 incumbent pipeline linear:price_us with sigmoid OOF recalibration on the premarket clock (from reliable._walk)
A5 incumbent pipeline linear:price_us on the postclose clock (US T-1, as published)
Each feature-block candidate (C2, C3, C4) is compared with C1 on identical dates (block removal ablation)
multiple_testing: Holm step-down across 12 tests (6 candidates x 2 markets) at family-wise alpha 0.05, one-sided p-value = (1 + #{bootstrap mean of (candidate - up_rate) Brier difference >= 0}) / 2001 on the primary window
development_gate_per_candidate_market: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 on the primary window (Brier below up-rate)
secondary 252 development block: Brier point estimate below up-rate
log loss not worse than up-rate on both windows
no single-year slice with Brier worse than up-rate by more than 0.01
decision_if_passed: Implement as a research/shadow family behind config with production_weight 0; incumbent output unchanged; forward confirmation required before any promotion discussion.
decision_if_none_passed: Report the non-result; implement nothing in the serving path.
